reason: Address R2 design review findings: literal browser eight-case exact-set wrapper, exact five-test recipient_ack runtime wrapper with parsed denominator, post-bind/base-to-current exact three-path scope validator, and source-grounded authentic handler-output artifact handoff.

acceptance_criteria: AC-1: #112/#265/#270 terminal caches validate canonical and their merges are ancestral to the execution base.
AC-2: Observatory consumes only the served #270 response schema and never treats request acceptance as delivery.
AC-3: Delivered, refused, failed, revoked, and recovery states are distinct, visible, accessible, and action-safe.

AC-4: Raw correlation identifiers, signed messages, private keys, proof hashes, provider payloads, policy details, and opaque signed request/acknowledgement material do not render, log, cache, or persist.

AC-5: Post-bind scope validation compares the bound branch from its exact execution base to current main and accepts exactly three product/test paths: demos/html-observatory/app.js, demos/html-observatory/styles.css, and adl/tools/validate_layer8_authority_observatory_ui.sh, plus issue-local lifecycle/evidence surfaces.

AC-6: The browser wrapper exercises the actual Observatory assets through the literal eight-case exact set: delivered, signed refusal, malformed response failure, unavailable Runtime recovery, revoked demotion, action release, keyboard/live-region accessibility, and forbidden-field non-disclosure; every case must be nonzero and zero/ignored/skipped/missing/duplicated cases fail closed.

AC-7: The runtime wrapper invokes the real adl-runtime-kernel recipient_ack handler path, parses the denominator, and passes only when exactly five nonzero tests cover delivered acknowledgement, signed refusal, generation binding, malformed/unknown status rejection, and raw-correlation redaction.
AC-8: Browser fixtures consume a source-grounded authentic handler-output artifact handoff from the runtime wrapper; loopback-only or mocked conversation-frame evidence is not accepted.
AC-9: Fresh design review and fresh exact-head implementation review have no actionable findings before publication.

steps.action: Validate terminal #112/#265/#270 dependencies, current-main base, exact scope, and collision freedom without binding or product edits.
Obtain fresh design review over the repaired design/card packet and bind #271 through typed v2 in FastWork only if the review passes.
Implement the Runtime-owned acknowledgement adapter and distinct accessible UI states within the exact three product/test paths.
Implement the exact five-test recipient_ack runtime wrapper and use its source-grounded authentic handler-output artifact handoff as the browser fixture source.
Implement the literal eight-case browser wrapper with per-test nonzero assertions and zero/ignored/skipped/missing/duplicated case rejection.
Run exact validation, fresh exact-head implementation review, publication, CI, finish, and release #278 only after terminal ancestry.
